title: HindSight: A Graph-Based Vision Model Architecture For Representing Part-Whole Hierarchies
abstract: arXiv:2104.03722v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper presents a model architecture for encoding the representations of part-whole hierarchies in images in form of a graph. The idea is to divide the image into patches of different levels and then treat all of these patches as nodes for a fully connected graph. A dynamic feature extraction module is used to extract feature representations from these patches in each graph iteration. This enables us to learn a rich graph representation of the image that encompasses the inherent part-whole hierarchical information. Utilizing proper self-supervised training techniques, such a model can be trained as a general purpose vision encoder model which can then be used for various vision related downstream tasks (e.g., Image Classification, Object Detection, Image Captioning, etc.).

translated_title: HindSight：一种用于表示部分-整体层次结构的基于图的视觉模型架构
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种以图的形式编码图像中部分-整体层次结构表示的模型架构。其核心思想是将图像划分为不同层级的图像块，然后将所有这些图像块作为全连接图的节点。在每次图迭代中，使用动态特征提取模块从这些图像块中提取特征表示。这使我们能够学习到包含图像固有部分-整体层次信息的丰富图表示。利用适当的自监督训练技术，这样的模型可以被训练成一个通用视觉编码器模型，进而用于各种视觉相关的下游任务（例如图像分类、目标检测、图像描述生成等）。
tldr: 该论文提出了HindSight架构，通过将图像划分为不同层级的图像块并构建全连接图来编码图像中的部分-整体层次结构，可训练为通用视觉编码器以支持多种视觉下游任务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HindSight, a graph-based vision model architecture that encodes part-whole hierarchies in images by dividing them into multi-level patches as nodes of a fully connected graph, enabling training as a general-purpose vision encoder for various downstream vision tasks.
